source.from: https://www.wowhead.com/forever/world-map (zone grid + zoom-4 tile alpha; no textures kept)
source.units: Wowhead world-canvas px; 512 px = one 533.33-yard chunk. Zone % coords: x = (X - rect.x1) / (rect.x2 - rect.x1) * 100 using the zone rect in world_map_layout.json places. Each zone's rect ([[x1,y1],[x2,y2]], from Wowhead's layout) maps in-game zone coordinates onto the canvas.
source.precision: land/water every 8 px, zone membership every 32 px, simplified to 6.0 px; pieces with no zone in the game data are merged into the neighbouring zone they share the longest border with (as the in-game map draws them)
source.polygon_format: polygons = [ polygon, ... ]; polygon = [ outer_ring, hole_ring, ... ]; ring = [[x,y], ...] (implicitly closed)
